ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 98:2 ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white) pixels on the visible fluke surface, excluding the overexposed lower margin.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid black pigmentation across the macro-surface area. High-intensity white clusters are localized at the distal tips of both lobes and in a sparse scattering across the right lobe upper-mid section.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 95 degrees, reaching a depth of roughly 30% of the total fluke vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire boundary. Notable peaks occur at regular intervals of 15-20 pixels, with deep jagged valleys near the distal lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex upward curves originating from the median notch and terminating at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of circular white spots (approximately 5-8 distinct points) visible on the far right distal tip and a smaller cluster of 3 points on the left distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct vertical white linear marks located in the left-central and right-central interior regions of the fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged notch and minor truncation on the far left distal tip; irregular edge morphology on the right distal tip suggests historical physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: The lower central boundary of the fluke is obscured by high-intensity (white) pixel saturation, consistent with water splash or overexposure.
